name: Ranger Bounty Hunter
body:
The bounty hunter uses their immense skill at tracking and survival to track down their quarry and bring them to justice.

Quarry (Ex)

Beginning at 1st level, as a standard action bounty hunter can denote one target within their line of sight, or for 1 hour review a bounty or use Diplomacy to gather information, to designate a target as their quarry. Whenever they are following the tracks of their quarry, a bounty hunter can take 10 on their Survival skill checks while moving at normal speed, without penalty. In addition, they receive a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, Perception checks, Sense Motive checks, Survival checks, and Diplomacy checks to gather information made against their quarry.

Additionally, all critical threats are automatically confirmed. They can dismiss this effect at any time as a free action, but they cannot select a new quarry for 24 hours. If the bounty hunter sees proof that their quarry is dead, or if they have successfully subdued them via non-lethal damage, they can select a new quarry after waiting 1 hour.

At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, the bonuses against the quarry increase by +2.

At 11th level, the bounty hunter can designate a quarry as a free action within line of sight or take 10 minutes to review a bounty or gather information via Diplomacy. Additionally if the quarry is killed or subdued, the bounty hunter can select a new quarry after 10 minutes. Finally, the bounty hunter can take 20 to follow the tracks of their quarry.

This ability replaces favored enemy and the quarry gained at 11th level.

Bring ‘em Back Alive (Ex)

It is very important for a bounty hunter to be able to cash in on their marks. At 1st level a bounty hunter can choose to do non-lethal damage with any weapon with which they are proficient without penalty. In addition, the bounty hunter increases the damage bonus from the quarry ability by 50% when dealing non-lethal damage to their quarry.

This ability replaces wild empathy.

Crippling Strike (Ex)

Bounty hunters learn to efficiently slow the reflexes and defenses of their marks.

At 7th level, as a swift action the bounty can deal 2 Dexterity damage to their quarry on a successful hit.

This ability is usable a number of times equal to their Wisdom modifier.

This ability replaces woodland stride and improved quarry.

Track the Unseen (Su)

At 10th level, the bounty hunter gains the ability to track their marks even while the mark is benefiting from pass without trace or similar magic, though at a -10 penalty.

This ability replaces the combat style feat gained at 10th level.

Master Bounty Hunter (Ex)

A bounty hunter of 20th level becomes a master of their craft. They can always move at full speed while using Survival to follow the tracks of their quarry without penalty. They can, as a standard action, make a single attack against their quarry at their full attack bonus. If the attack hits, the target takes damage normally and must make a Fortitude save or be rendered unconscious. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 the bounty hunter’s level + their Wisdom modifier. On a failure, the target is dealt non-lethal damage equal to their remaining hit points. A successful save halves this damage or deals the weapon’s normal damage as non-lethal damage, whichever is higher. A bounty hunter can use this ability a number of times equal to 3 + their Wisdom modifier, but not against the same creature more than once in a 24-hour period.

This ability replaces master hunter.
